title: Live: Several blasts heard coming from northern Tehran
summary: Several blasts were reportedly heard in northern Tehran on Saturday as the Middle East war neared its sixth week. Meanwhile, Iranian and American forces are racing to recover the missing crew member from an American warplane shot down by Iran on Saturday. Follow our liveblog for updates.
contentText: Several blasts were heard at a petrochemical zone in Iran’s southwestern Khuzestan province on Saturday, with state media reporting casualties and extensive damage from US-Israeli strikes. Meanwhile, Iranian and US forces raced to recover the missing crew member from an American warplane shot down by Iran. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.
